headline: VERITAS Scores 88.9% on Replication. The Science Crisis It's Trying to Fix Scores Much Worse.

seo.meta_title: VERITAS AI Replication Tool Misses the Real Crisis
seo.meta_description: VERITAS scores 88.9% on CORE-Bench. But when 85% of AI studies never share code, automating replication is the wrong solution to the right problem.
